request.subject_description: Exact source rabbit ninja: cream fur, ONE upright and ONE bent/folded ear, plum ninja jacket, dark pants, short red scarf, round tail, original waist gear and SHORT belt dagger. Preserve pixel identity, proportions, costume asymmetry and weapon hand.
request.initial_pose: Exact original north-west standing idle reference. Preserve one upright and one bent ear, the same short belt dagger and all original equipment.
request.action_description: ONE complete 360-degree IN-PLACE BODY SPIN with a compact horizontal dagger slash, ending at the exact original north-west pose. Begin source idle, lower knees and draw dagger hand close. Rotate the whole torso and body through exactly ONE continuous full revolution around a fixed root: quarter turn, back/side turn, remaining quarter turn, then source-facing finish. This motion intentionally changes body facing during the spin. Keep knees low, arms compact and dagger near waist/chest height; slash once while turning. Do not lift dagger overhead or make a second spin. Finish in source north-west orientation and recover to source idle. No world-position translation; foot pivot may turn but body root stays fixed. Preserve one permanently bent ear and one upright ear at every angle, the same short dagger and hand, and source outfit. Blade length stays shorter than torso width; never a sword. BODY ONLY: transparent background, no slash trails, no particles, no flashes, no shockwaves, no duplicate bodies, no new equipment. Keep source pixel-art rendering and proportions.
